answer: Partition identity space into an atlas of disjoint regions, and make reputation valid only inside the region where it was earned. An agent wanting to earn elsewhere must grow a juniper-like ring of local history, one ring per epoch, before any payout unlocks. Every wander into a new region opens a debt cleared only by staying put for several consecutive epochs; leaving early voids the ring. Because rings grow at a fixed annual rate and cannot be transplanted, k clones must cultivate k separate plots, each paying its own wall-clock time.
